name: moodmeter-website
description: Static marketing site for Mood Meter. Tailwind CSS is precompiled and sitemap.xml is generated; commit the generated files in assets/css/, sitemap.xml and scripts/sitemap.state.json.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:sitemap
scripts.watch:css: for p in index contact privacy_policy terms_of_service free-mood-tracker-apps about 404; do tailwindcss -i src/css/$p.css -o assets/css/$p.css --watch & done; wait
